properties.headline: Area South of Franklin Canyon to Icy Springs/Wohali in Ready Status
properties.description: Residents south of Franklin Canyon to Icy Springs/Wohali Way have been placed in 'Ready' Status to plan for possible evacuation due to the Rocky Canyon Fire. Be prepared to evacuate. This is NOT an evacuation order. Please gather important documents, prepare your vehicles, your animals, gather medicines, and an evacuation bag. Please do not call 911 for updates. Continue to monitor for official information available at https://www.summitcounty.info/emergency and Utah Fire Info.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 9 at 7:25PM EDT until August 9 at 10:30PM EDT by NWS Raleigh NC
properties.description:
FFWRAH

The National Weather Service in Raleigh has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southwestern Harnett County in central North Carolina...
Northeastern Hoke County in central North Carolina...
East Central Moore County in central North Carolina...

* Until 1030 PM EDT.

* At 725 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 2.5 and 3 inches of rain
have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 2 to 2.5 inches in 1
hour. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are possible in
the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Whispering Pines, Vass and Cameron.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

properties.description:

SOURCE...Emergency management reported.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban
areas, highways, streets and underpasses as well as
other poor drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Bland...                           Bastian...
Kimberling...                      Long Spur...

This includes the following streams and drainages...
Sulphur Spring Fork, Walker Creek, Hunting Camp Creek, Crab

properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

In hilly terrain there are hundreds of low water crossings which are
potentially dangerous in heavy rain. Do not attempt to cross flooded
roads. Find an alternate route.

When it is safe to do so, please send your reports of flooding,
including mudslides or flooded roads, to the National Weather
Service by calling toll free at 1...8 6 6...2 1 5...4 3 2 4. Reports
and pictures can also be shared on the National Weather Service
Blacksburg Facebook page and on X.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 6:00PM MST until August 9 at 6:30PM MST by NWS Phoenix AZ
properties.description:
SVRPSR

The National Weather Service in Phoenix has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Pinal County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 630 PM MST.

* At 600 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm was located 9 miles east of
Florence, moving west at 5 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Florence.

This includes AZ Route 79 between mile markers 129 and 145.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Large hail, damaging wind, and continuous cloud to ground lightning
are occurring with this storm. Move indoors immediately. Lightning is
one of nature's leading killers. Remember, if you can hear thunder,
you are close enough to be struck by lightning.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with this storm, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.
